authority: Original supplied references and explicit user brief

checks.label: Large light/dark masses
checks.question: At thumbnail scale compare focal light, background value groups and the amount of black. Bright pixels alone are insufficient.

checks.label: Warm/cool balance and shadow color
checks.question: Compare lit and shadow families, colored fill and broad warm/cool integration, not just a sky or lamp color.

checks.label: Atmospheric depth and edge loss
checks.question: Compare foreground/midground/background contrast, haze color, silhouettes and selective edge softness. Blur is not equivalent to atmosphere.
subchecks: Density units, domain extent/path length and preserved dark recesses
Physical scattering versus explicitly artistic world-space depth palette

checks.label: Material-specific painted structure
checks.question: At hero and native near scales, inspect broad directional marks, sparse accents, form-following wear and material identity. Inspect shape, edge loss, physical scale and repetition even for authored image masks; avoid wood-like cloth bands, closed polygon stamps and uniform noise.

checks.label: People and setting coherence
checks.question: Compare scale, shape language, painted finish and lighting of figures with the setting. Do not alter accepted anatomy to conceal a shading mismatch.

checks.label: Grounding and usable construction
checks.question: Check real visible support, exposed joints, deck clearance and silhouettes. Separate intentional supports from exposed coplanar faces and route obstructions.
subchecks: Physical support versus verified pigment/volume envelopes
Rail/stile exposed faces versus overlapping parked/fixed sheets
Support, passage clearance and surface competition have separate scopes

checks.label: Causal and reproducible evidence
checks.question: Bind actual source/scene/image hashes, runtime camera/light fields, engine, samples, seed, view transform and changed modules. Inspect fixed-camera A/Bs before calling a fix accepted.
subchecks: Stored-state check versus observed rendered behavior
Actual in-frame target in each witness
Finite accepted/open clauses and retained negative tests

rules: Passing technical checks does not establish art acceptance
Inspect actual rendered pixels at hero, meaningful alternate, near, and changed-light views
Generated concept art is labelled reference, never scene evidence
Existing robustness matrices are not necessarily art-direction A/Bs; state whether world and sky changed
Preserve failed evidence and strict numerical failures separately from a nonblocking disposition
Graph/RNA readback proves stored state, not actual renderer efficacy; test actual decoded output.
Prior scoped findings carry forward only while current user feedback and the actual whole-image goal do not invalidate their artistic closure.
Verify the affected target is in-frame in every claimed view; offscreen/negative-index crops are invalid evidence.
Current scene examples can be accepted in their own scope while every built-in non-neutral preset remains experimental.
A critic pass is not user approval; the Japanese v13 rejection supersedes its prior art completion claim.

finite_closure.reopen_only_on: Fresh regression, invalidated dependency, broader reference mismatch or explicit user rejection; a restricted ledger may itself need reassessment.
finite_closure.technical_failures: Keep raw FAIL and independent nonblocking disposition separate.
finite_closure.user_feedback_override: Explicit user rejection supersedes prior critic artistic acceptance. Preserve measured technical facts separately and reopen holistic style assessment.
